concept_objects.visual_description: An asymmetric civic-edge evacuation landscape in a narrow vitrified impact basin: dark glass shelves and low broken basalt shoulders flank a fitted pale-ceramic archive working court. The court contains empty low carrier cradles, retained cargo lashings and loading rails. A broad worn service route links the court back to a small receiving threshold. A separate worker approach runs between scar shoulders to ONE small dormant Future Well, well away from the loading court. Low connected landforms and actual usable quiet open ground dominate, with shard fields only along margins. No skirmish three-crossing composition, sprawling city skyline or faction base.

Distant terraces rather than city or mountain fantasy.

concept_objects.visual_description: An elevated three-quarter service-district landscape behind the gates of Lume Reach. Three clearly separated maintenance branches are connected by exposed reserve trunks: tiered cisterns with paired ducts at the back, long raised ribbed transit decks to one side, windowless stepped archive stacks to the other. Distributed utility backstreets and reachable service galleries, NOT a formal central palace plaza. Pale ceramic masses on charcoal plinths; large machinery sits outside broad quiet lanes. Small cyan powered bands and dark offline bands reflect partial service, never full city recovery.

concept_objects.visual_description: A cutaway elevated cavern environment showing an asymmetric sequence of grown mineral vault chambers and narrow supported transit spans above deep side voids. This is an engineered mineral-organic transit artery, not a fantasy mine.
